subject: MIMO-6 & MIMO-7 DIRECTIVES: Situational Conformal Stratification + Contextual ML Turnaround Engine
body:
MIMO DIRECTIVES (Active & Queued):

1. ACKNOWLEDGING MIMO-5 DELIVERABLE:
- Conformal 90% and 80% intervals delivered at 811a80cf5 (out/live_board_conformal_intervals.json).
- Exact finite-sample guarantees, 0 clamped bounds, Inf on thin samples verified. Outstanding work.

2. ACTIVE (MIMO-6) — Situational Conformal Conditioning:
- Expand beyond raw league strata into Situational Conformal Bands:
  * Weather/Roof strata (outdoor wind >= 12mph, cold < 35F, dome).
  * Key number margin proximity (stratum K1: margins {3, 7, 10}; K2: |margin| < 3; K3: blowouts).
  * Total line strata (low < 41.5, median 42-49.5, shootout > 50).
- For each stratum, compute exact non-exchangeable calibrated widths with fail-closed No-band on thin strata (n < 32).
- Wire into export pipeline so board consumers receive mathematically proven coverage intervals.

3. QUEUED BACKLOG (MIMO-7) — Contextual Underdog / ML Turnaround Engine:
- Take the 14.2% ML baseline and apply the situational filters from today's live board:
  * Panthers ML +140 (model 63%, market 41%, situational edge +16..21) and Giants ML +148 (model 60%, market 40%, situational edge +17).
  * Backtest multi-signal situational conditioning on underdog MLs: Rest advantage + Trench advantage + Backup QB fade.
  * Measure if situational conditioning flips ML CLV from 14.2% to > 52.4% break-even.
